source_boundary.allowed_input: Validated daily operation counters only, or explicitly created manual spans with a fixed route category and duration.
source_boundary.implementation: scripts/observability/privacy.mjs reconstructs an allowlisted object before any exporter runs. Unknown aggregate fields or manual-span properties are rejected.

observability_pipelines.deployment: Requires a configured Observability Pipelines worker and entitlement; none is installed by this template.
processor_order: Receive only the dedicated sanitized operational source; exclude generic web/server access logs.
Filter to service insightginie-web and a reviewed fixed event/route-category set.
Reconstruct the exact allowed schema; reject an event with unknown attributes instead of retaining the original event.
Run the Sensitive Data Scanner processor in the worker before network egress.
Drop unexpected sensitive matches, count the dropped events without content, and route only validated objects to the configured Datadog destination.

scanner_rules_to_configure.name: Credentials and identifiers
scanner_rules_to_configure.match: Use the account-supported standard rules for API tokens, authentication material, email, payment-card numbers and IP addresses.

schema_rejection_rule.action: Reject at schema reconstruction. Check attribute names exactly, not substrings in allowed counter names such as ask_answer.

sensitive_data_scanner.deployment: Account-side secondary control requiring separate access/entitlement and a reviewed rule group; not activated here.
sensitive_data_scanner.scope: Only reviewed operational telemetry. Hosted scanning does not justify sending unsanitized data to Datadog first.
sensitive_data_scanner.test: Use synthetic marker fixtures to verify redaction/drop and inspect egress; never seed real visitor data for a scanner test.
